notes.title: 2025 April MechaNest - Continue building!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're making great progress on [b]District One[/b], the area where your adventure in MechaNest begins. It's really coming to life!

We've also filled the mysterious Tubes in the Start Zone with eerie fluid and—yes—bodies! The atmosphere is getting darker and more immersive. 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221796/72fcc3a9beec886cb17061c986eae0ab808d4b9f.jpg[/img]

From the Start Zone, players can now travel through the tubes to access different Districts. The world is expanding!

notes.title: 2025 February MechaNest - Ongoing Work on the Environment
notes.content:
[b]Hi Everyone,[/b]

We’d like to update you on the ongoing work in [b]MechaNest[/b]. Currently, we’re focused on [b]rebuilding the districts[/b] with handcrafted, carefully placed props.

As part of this process, we’ve decided to move away [b]from using procedurally generated environments[/b] in MechaNest. Our goal is to ensure that you, as a player, can explore and adventure through MechaNest at your own pace, without any time limits or restrictions in the environment.

Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to sharing more updates with you soon!

notes.title: MechaNest Escaping the Labyrinth.
notes.content:
Hi Explorers,

Today i want to share the plans for the first part of MechaNest that is currently being build.
There is still along way to go but the future looks great.

The plan is to start the MechaNest quest in the mazes of MechaNest city.
So in short MechaNest city is situated at the center of the planet Merador.

Because MechaNest has a long story and being build by a very small team we want to start in the mazes.
So we can start running around and build up a community of people who are interested in this game genre and who wants to help testing the game.

So the plans for the first section of the game will be.

[u][b]Escaping the Labyrinth[/b][/u]
Here is the player trapped deep within the main city.
All control of the safety systems and machines are taken over by AI or just disabled.

Our first objective is to get out this maze and start up the safety system again.

[b][u]How do we need to do this?[/u][/b]
Objective 1:
Farm Blue Energy Crystals.
These Energy Crystals can be combined at a Energy Fuser in to Energy Cores.

The Energy Cores can be placed at a Energy Disperser to power up a section of the game or distributes them throughout the game world to specific locations if needed.

Objective 2:
Farm Orange Charge Crystals, dropped by the fallen enemies.
These shards are specifically designed to enhance the player's offensive abilities, allowing them to unleash more powerful or charged attacks.

[u][b]What will happen when we are testing the first release?[/b][/u]
In the meanwhile we solve the problems if needed and start building the next section of MechaNest.

There are many rooms to explore in the city towers and they need to be build.
You can alway's go check Phil Berex his livestream on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/philberex]TWITCH[/url]
Or check the devlogs and other video's on the [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCV7vNPETI2BaoFXNrJC0t8g]Youtube channel[/url]

See you soon!

Kind regards Phil.
